notes.title: The Doll Beneath Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Just a simple bug fix / quality of life improvement patch. Nothing too crazy!

[b]REMOVED[/b]
-Invisible trigger at the end of Episode 1, Chapter 4
-Invisible trigger in Episode 2, Chapter 2

[b]CHANGED[/b]
-Made changes to door code puzzle in Episode 2, Chapter 2
-Unreleased episodes in the main menu now have a different color from the released episodes

notes.title: The Doll Beneath 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello! Since the launch of The Doll Beneath, me, as well as a couple other players ran into a few nasty bugs. Time to get those squashed! If you run into any other bugs, be sure to let me know on the steam discussion page!

[b]FIXED[/b]
-Clipping issues on map in Episode 2
-Typos in the intro of Episode 2
-Major freezing glitch during certain cutscenes
